text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
BURSA
- The Romanian State Ownership Fund (FPS) would like Germany's Krupp to be among the four foreign bidders in the privatisation of the Otelinox steel plant in Tirgoviste.
- Dye maker Policolor to be privatised soon. In the first five months it had a gross profit of 14.8 billion lei.
ADEVARUL
- The Romanian government ruled to suspend payment of agricultural taxes starting 1997 to 1999.
- Foreigners can be the managers of Romanian companies, says a government decree adopted last weekend.
ROMANIA LIBERA
- The newspaper publishes the government programme for rehabilitating rural roads, electricity an water supplies.
- The newspaper publishes excerpts of the national housing fund bill drafted by the public works ministry aimed to build cheap gouses and to solve the housing crisis in Romania.
- The Romanian Development Agency and the National Privatisation Agency would be reorganised and merged into a single institute, said sources close to the Reform Ministry.
General:
ADEVARUL
- Romanian President Emil Constantinescu said joining NATO's first eastward expansion is a matter of dignity for Romania.

- The Alliance for Romania, a new party built by dissidents from the former leftist ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) would support a minority government if the present centrist coalition breaks.
ROMANIA LIBERA

- The foreign ministry spokeswoman was sacked over accusations of "discrediting the Romanian government and foreign ministry," the government said in a statement after last Saturday's cabinet meeting.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- U.S. President Bill Clinton will adress Romanians in University Square during his visit to Bucharest on Friday.

- President Emil Constantinescu stepped in to defuse the conflict between the main coalition partners -- the National Peasant Party and the Democratic Party -- over a report alleging some PD members had illegaly acquired houses.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- The opposition PDSR said the Romanian government should resign if Romania fails to join NATO.
-- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
